pill.code.diagnose.prompt:
Help me diagnose a problem with Atic (version {version}, {os}).

Before proposing anything, investigate:
- Read the most recent pill log in {logs} (files named pill.<date>.log).
- Check the configuration in {data}, without showing keys or tokens.
- Look for whether it is already a known problem at https://github.com/chrx3/atic/issues.

Ask before applying a fix or publishing anything. If it is worth reporting, draft an issue (title, steps to reproduce, version and a log excerpt without personal data) for me to review.

What happened:
